title: Bitcoin Price Trades Near $77,500 as Midterm Voting Begins
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Trades Near $77,500 as Midterm Voting Begins Bitcoin price trades near $77,500 as midterm voting begins, pressured by a record $6.3 billion Binance hack, ETF outflows, a Fed leaning toward a December hike and oil above $100 on Iran tensions. This post Bitcoin Price Trades Near $77,500 as Midterm Voting Begins first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
